input.question: How do I reset my password?

expected.answer: Open Settings → Security and click "Reset password". You'll get an email with a one-time link within a minute. Links expire after 15 minutes.

input.question: Where do I find my invoice?

expected.answer: Invoices live under Billing → History. Click any row to open the PDF or use Download all for a 12-month zip.

input.question: How can I invite someone to my workspace?

expected.answer: Go to Settings → Team and click "Invite member". Choose a role (Owner / Editor / Viewer) and send the invite by email.

input.question: Can I change my workspace name?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → General → Workspace name. Saves immediately and updates across the UI in a few seconds.

input.question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?

expected.answer: Settings → Security → Two-factor authentication. Scan the QR with any authenticator app and confirm a six-digit code to finish setup.

input.question: How do I export my project data?

expected.answer: Open the project, choose Export from the … menu, and pick CSV or JSON. Large exports are emailed when ready.

input.question: Where can I find my API key?

expected.answer: Settings → API → Personal access tokens. Generate a new token and copy it immediately — we don't show the value again.

input.question: How do I cancel my subscription?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Plan → Cancel. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle and your data stays accessible until then.

input.question: Can I get a refund?

expected.answer: Within 14 days of the most recent charge, contact support@example.com and we'll process a full refund. After 14 days we credit your next invoice.

input.question: How do I upload an avatar?

expected.answer: Click your profile icon (top-right) → Profile → Upload image. PNG or JPG, up to 5MB.

input.question: Does the app work offline?

expected.answer: Read access works offline for projects you've opened in the last 7 days. Changes queue locally and sync when you reconnect.

input.question: Can I have multiple workspaces?

expected.answer: Yes — your account can own or belong to as many workspaces as your plan allows. Switch via the workspace picker in the top-left.

input.question: How do I share a project externally?

expected.answer: Open the project → Share → Create public link. You can set view-only or comment, and add an expiry date.

input.question: How do I change the billing email?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Billing contact. Invoices and renewal notices route to that address.

input.question: Does the platform support SSO?

expected.answer: Yes, SAML and Google SSO are available on the Team and Enterprise plans. Settings → Security → SSO.

input.question: How long are deleted projects retained?

expected.answer: 30 days in a soft-delete state. Restore from Settings → Trash. After 30 days they're permanently removed.

input.question: Can I import data from a CSV?

expected.answer: Open a project → Add → Import → CSV. Map your columns to ours in the import wizard and click Import.

input.question: How do I leave a workspace?

expected.answer: Settings → Team → Your row → Leave workspace. Workspace owners must transfer ownership before they can leave.

input.question: How do I rename a project?

expected.answer: Click the project name at the top of the project view and type the new one. Press Enter to save.

input.question: Can I customize email notifications?

expected.answer: Settings → Notifications. Toggle each event independently or set a Quiet hours window.

input.question: How do I add a custom domain?

expected.answer: Settings → Domains → Add. We'll show DNS records to add and verify within 5 minutes of propagation.

input.question: Where are server regions located?

expected.answer: We run in us-east, us-west, eu-west, and ap-southeast. Choose your region during workspace creation. Changing region later requires support.

input.question: How do I rotate my API key?

expected.answer: Settings → API → tokens. Click Rotate next to the token. The old key stops working immediately, so update integrations first.

input.question: Do you support webhooks?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Webhooks. Add an endpoint, select events, and verify signatures using the provided secret.

input.question: Can I assign tasks to multiple people?

expected.answer: On the Team plan and above, yes. Editor → Add assignees and add as many teammates as the task needs.

input.question: What's the file upload limit?

expected.answer: 100MB per file on Free, 1GB on Team, 5GB on Enterprise.

input.question: How do I tag projects?

expected.answer: Open a project → Details → Tags. Type a new tag or pick an existing one. Tags help with filtering and search.

input.question: Can I see who edited a record last?

expected.answer: Hover the timestamp on any record. Audit log is on the Team plan and above.

input.question: How do I change my display name?

expected.answer: Settings → Profile → Display name. Updates show up across the UI within a minute.

input.question: Can I trial paid features?

expected.answer: Yes — start a 14-day trial of the Team plan from Settings → Billing. No card required.

input.question: Does the product have a mobile app?

expected.answer: iOS and Android apps are in the respective app stores. Same login as the web app.

input.question: How do I pause my subscription?

expected.answer: We don't pause subscriptions, but you can downgrade to Free at any time and keep your data.

input.question: Can I lock a project from edits?

expected.answer: Yes — Project → Settings → Lock project. Only Owners can lock or unlock.

input.question: How do I see usage against my plan limit?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Usage. We also email you when you hit 80% of any limit.

input.question: Where do I report a bug?

expected.answer: Click the ? in the bottom-right and choose Report a bug. We respond within one business day on Team / Enterprise.

input.question: How are passwords stored?

expected.answer: Hashed with bcrypt and never logged. We also offer SSO to eliminate password storage entirely for Team / Enterprise.

input.question: Can I have read-only API access?

expected.answer: Yes — when you create a token, choose Read-only. Read-only keys cannot mutate any resource.

input.question: How do I add a billing tax ID?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Tax information. Enter your VAT / GST / business tax ID and we'll include it on every invoice.

input.question: Can I download all my data on cancellation?

expected.answer: Yes — within 30 days of cancellation, Settings → Billing → Export everything will give you a zip of every project as JSON + CSV.

input.question: Do you sign Data Processing Agreements?

expected.answer: Yes, on the Team and Enterprise plans. Email legal@example.com to receive our standard DPA.

input.question: How do I integrate with Slack?

expected.answer: Settings → Integrations → Slack → Connect. Authorize the workspace and choose channels for notifications.

input.question: Can I assign multiple roles to a teammate?

expected.answer: Roles are exclusive within a workspace — one role per teammate. You can be different roles in different workspaces.

input.question: How do I move a project to another workspace?

expected.answer: Open the project → … → Move project. Pick the destination workspace where you have at least Editor permissions.

input.question: Where do I configure email digest frequency?

expected.answer: Settings → Notifications → Email → Digest. Choose Immediate, Hourly, or Daily.

input.question: Do you support audit log export?

expected.answer: Yes on Enterprise. Settings → Audit log → Export. CSV format with one row per event.

input.question: How do I delete my account permanently?

expected.answer: Settings → Account → Delete account. Requires a second confirmation. Account and all owned workspaces are deleted after a 7-day grace period.

input.question: Can I use a custom email domain for sent notifications?

expected.answer: Yes on Enterprise — Settings → Domains → Custom sender. Add a DKIM record and verify.

input.question: How do I report a security vulnerability?

expected.answer: Email security@example.com with the details. We acknowledge within 48 hours and run a coordinated-disclosure program.

input.question: Does the platform meet SOC 2 standards?

expected.answer: We're SOC 2 Type II certified. Request the latest report from your account manager or via security@example.com.

input.question: How are project archives different from deletes?

expected.answer: Archive hides a project from your list but keeps all data. Delete moves it to Trash for 30 days, then removes permanently.

input.question: Can I rate-limit my API key?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → API → tokens → token details. Set a per-minute and per-day cap on each token.

input.question: How do I see who's online in my workspace?

expected.answer: Sidebar → Presence shows who has the workspace open right now. Available on Team and above.

input.question: What happens when I exceed my plan's user limit?

expected.answer: We don't block — you get a 7-day grace period to upgrade or remove members. Notifications fire from day 1.

input.question: How do I bulk-edit records?

expected.answer: Select rows by checkbox → Actions → Edit. Choose fields to update across all selected rows.

input.question: Can I undo a bulk edit?

expected.answer: Yes within 60 seconds — a toast at the bottom of the screen offers Undo. After that, restore from the project's version history.

input.question: Where do I configure single-sign-on?

expected.answer: Settings → Security → SSO → Configure. We support SAML 2.0 and OIDC.

input.question: Do you support webhook signature verification?

expected.answer: Yes — every payload includes an X-Signature header that's an HMAC-SHA256 of the body using your webhook secret.

input.question: How are workspaces billed when sharing teammates?

expected.answer: Each workspace is billed independently. Teammates in two workspaces count against each workspace's plan separately.

input.question: Can I download an attachment without opening the project?

expected.answer: Yes from the global search — search for the filename, hover the result, and click the download icon.

input.question: How long does data export take?

expected.answer: Small projects (< 10MB) are immediate. Larger exports are emailed when ready, usually within 10 minutes.

input.question: Do you offer educational discounts?

expected.answer: Yes — 50% off any plan for accredited schools. Email edu@example.com from a school address.

input.question: Can I get a quote for an annual contract?

expected.answer: Yes for the Team plan and above. Email sales@example.com with your seat count and term length.

input.question: How do I make a project template?

expected.answer: Open the project → … → Save as template. Templates show up under Add → From template when creating new projects.

input.question: How do I find shared projects?

expected.answer: Sidebar → Shared with me. Filter by owner or workspace if the list is long.

input.question: Can I lock fields in a project?

expected.answer: Yes — Field menu → Lock field. Editors cannot modify locked fields; Owners can unlock anytime.

input.question: Where do I see my API token usage?

expected.answer: Settings → API → tokens → Usage tab. Per-token request counts for the past 30 days.

input.question: How do I unsubscribe from product updates?

expected.answer: Footer of any product-update email or Settings → Notifications → Marketing → off.

input.question: Can I get usage data via the API?

expected.answer: Yes — GET /v1/billing/usage with a Read-Billing scope. Returns current-period totals and limit values.

input.question: How do I see the history of changes to a record?

expected.answer: Click a record → History tab. Shows every change with timestamp and actor for the past 90 days.

input.question: Do you support Single Sign-On with Okta?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Security → SSO → Okta. We provide the SAML metadata URL you need.

input.question: Can I have a sandbox workspace?

expected.answer: Team and Enterprise plans get one free sandbox workspace per paid workspace. Settings → Workspaces → Add sandbox.

input.question: How do I move a teammate between roles?

expected.answer: Settings → Team → teammate row → Role. Changes take effect immediately.

input.question: Are there rate limits on API calls?

expected.answer: 60 requests per minute per token by default. Enterprise plans can request higher limits via support.

input.question: How do I export only a single project as CSV?

expected.answer: Open the project → … → Export → CSV. Downloads instantly for projects under 50MB.

input.question: How are deleted teammates billed?

expected.answer: Removed teammates are prorated off your next invoice within an hour of removal.

input.question: Where do I find the API docs?

expected.answer: developers.example.com hosts the API reference. Settings → API has a link to the same page.

input.question: Can I undo deleting a record?

expected.answer: Yes within the 30-day Trash window. Settings → Trash → record → Restore.

input.question: How do I lock a specific field's value?

expected.answer: Field menu → Lock value. The value is preserved but editors can't change it.

input.question: Does the product work in dark mode?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Appearance → Dark, Light, or System.

input.question: How do I view billing history for the past year?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → History defaults to past year. Use the date filter to extend or narrow.

input.question: Can I set a custom email signature in product emails?

expected.answer: Yes on Enterprise — Settings → Domains → Custom sender → Signature.

input.question: How do I disable notifications during off hours?

expected.answer: Settings → Notifications → Quiet hours. Pick a daily window in your local time zone.

input.question: How do I see my plan's exact feature list?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Plan details. Lists every quota and feature with current usage.

input.question: Can I get billed in my local currency?

expected.answer: USD, EUR, GBP are billed natively. Other currencies are converted at our daily rate and shown on the invoice.

input.question: Where do I find webhook delivery logs?

expected.answer: Settings → Webhooks → endpoint → Deliveries. Shows the last 100 attempts with response codes.

input.question: How do I retry a failed webhook?

expected.answer: Settings → Webhooks → endpoint → Deliveries → failed row → Retry.

input.question: Can teammates see each other's API keys?

expected.answer: No — API keys are per-user and visible only to the owning user.

input.question: How do I disable a teammate without removing them?

expected.answer: Settings → Team → teammate → Disable. They retain history but can't log in until re-enabled.

input.question: Where do I find a teammate's last active time?

expected.answer: Settings → Team → teammate row. Hover the activity indicator for a precise timestamp.

input.question: Can I get a list of all integrations connected to my workspace?

expected.answer: Settings → Integrations → Connected. Each row links to the configuration page for that integration.

input.question: How do I configure a custom date format?

expected.answer: Settings → Workspace → Date format. Choose YYYY-MM-DD, MM/DD/YYYY, or DD/MM/YYYY.

input.question: Can I have approvers on a project?

expected.answer: Yes on Team and above — Project → Settings → Approvals → Add approver. Approvers must sign off before changes go live.

input.question: How do I customize the project sidebar?

expected.answer: Drag handles in the sidebar to reorder. Click Customize to hide or show sections.

input.question: How do I track time on a task?

expected.answer: Open a task → Timer icon. Start / stop logs time entries against the task. Reports under Project → Time.

input.question: Where do I find usage analytics?

expected.answer: Settings → Workspace → Analytics. Charts of records created, teammates active, and storage consumed over time.

input.question: How do I switch the workspace logo?

expected.answer: Settings → Workspace → Logo. Square PNG up to 2MB.

input.question: Can I lock down which IPs can access the workspace?

expected.answer: Yes on Enterprise — Settings → Security → IP allowlist. CIDR ranges accepted.

input.question: Does the product support custom fields?

expected.answer: Yes on Team and above — Project → Schema → Add field. Eight field types: text, number, date, select, multi-select, link, attachment, boolean.

input.question: How are custom fields exported?

expected.answer: Custom fields export as columns in CSV and as keys in JSON, named the same as in the UI.

input.question: How do I configure default views per project?

expected.answer: Open a view → Set as default. New visitors see the default view first.

input.question: Can I prevent teammates from leaving comments?

expected.answer: Yes — Project → Settings → Comments → Disable. Existing comments remain visible but no new ones can be posted.

input.question: How do I see my plan renewal date?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Plan. Renewal date is at the top with auto-renewal toggle.

input.question: Can I be billed annually instead of monthly?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Billing → Plan → Switch to annual. Annual billing saves about two months on most plans.

input.question: How do I see attachments across all projects?

expected.answer: Sidebar → Attachments. Filter by uploader, project, or date range.

input.question: Where do I see my session activity?

expected.answer: Settings → Security → Active sessions. Shows device, IP, and last activity for each active session.

input.question: How do I sign out of all other sessions?

expected.answer: Settings → Security → Active sessions → Sign out other sessions. Useful after a stolen-device incident.

input.question: Can I add comments to a closed project?

expected.answer: Yes if you have at least Viewer permission. Closed projects accept comments but not edits.

input.question: How do I customize record-level permissions?

expected.answer: Yes on Enterprise — Record → … → Permissions → Add rule. Combine roles, fields, and conditions.

input.question: Where do I check service status?

expected.answer: status.example.com shows current and historical uptime, plus incident reports.

input.question: How do I subscribe to service status updates?

expected.answer: status.example.com → Subscribe. Email, SMS, or Slack channel options.

input.question: Can I import an Asana / Trello project?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Imports → choose your source. Asana and Trello use OAuth; Notion and Jira import from a CSV / JSON export.

input.question: How do I track project goals?

expected.answer: Project → Goals tab. Define a target metric and the platform tracks progress against it on the dashboard.

input.question: Can I download my profile photo I uploaded?

expected.answer: Settings → Profile → Profile picture → Download. Returns the original file at upload size.

input.question: How do I see deletion history for a project?

expected.answer: Project → … → History → Filter: deletions. Shows every deleted record from the past 90 days.

input.question: How are tax-exempt customers handled?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Tax exemption → Upload certificate. We review within two business days and waive tax going forward.

input.question: Can I have two-factor enforced for my workspace?

expected.answer: Yes on Team and above — Settings → Security → Enforce 2FA. Teammates without 2FA are prompted to enable it on next login.

input.question: How do I find unused API tokens?

expected.answer: Settings → API → tokens → Sort by Last used. Tokens unused in 90+ days are flagged.

input.question: Can I name my API tokens?

expected.answer: Yes — every token has a name field. Useful for tracking which integration uses which token.

input.question: How do I get my workspace ID for support?

expected.answer: Settings → Workspace. The ID is shown at the top under the workspace name.

input.question: Can I delete only a subset of records?

expected.answer: Yes — select records by checkbox → Actions → Delete. Confirms count before deleting.

input.question: Where do I see the change log for the product?

expected.answer: Footer → What's new. Updates list every change shipped in the past 90 days.

input.question: Can I beta-test new features?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Account → Beta program → Opt in. You'll see new features earlier and may be asked for feedback.

input.question: How do I configure how dates display?

expected.answer: Settings → Workspace → Date format covers the workspace default; per-user override at Settings → Profile → Date format.

input.question: Can I share a single view with someone outside my workspace?

expected.answer: Yes — view menu → Share view → Create public link. Read-only with optional expiry.

input.question: How do I lock a workspace template?

expected.answer: Settings → Workspace → Templates → template → Lock. Editors can use it but cannot modify it.

input.question: How are usage spikes handled?

expected.answer: Soft caps at 110% of plan limit with email warnings; hard cap at 150% with a contact-sales prompt.

input.question: Can I have a co-billed account with a teammate?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Billing → Add billing contact. Both contacts receive invoices and can update payment methods.

input.question: How do I monitor my plan usage proactively?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Usage → Set alerts. Email when any limit crosses 50%, 80%, or 95%.

input.question: How do I switch between my workspaces?

expected.answer: Top-left workspace picker. Cmd-K → workspace name also jumps you directly.

input.question: Can I customize keyboard shortcuts?

expected.answer: Yes on Team and above — Settings → Profile → Keyboard shortcuts. Remap any action.

input.question: How do I bulk-import attachments?

expected.answer: Sidebar → Attachments → Upload → multi-select files. They land in the project you've selected.

input.question: Can I limit which teammates see which projects?

expected.answer: Yes — Workspace → Projects → project → Visibility → Private to selected teammates.

input.question: Where do I update my mailing address for invoices?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Billing address. Updates apply to the next invoice.

input.question: How are invoices delivered?

expected.answer: Email to the billing contact, downloadable from Settings → Billing → History, and optionally cc'd to a finance address.

input.question: Can I pay my invoice with a bank transfer?

expected.answer: Yes on Team and above — Settings → Billing → Payment method → Bank transfer. We'll provide the bank details.

input.question: How do I export comments from a project?

expected.answer: Project → … → Export → Comments. CSV with author, timestamp, record reference, and comment body.

input.question: Where do I find the data residency setting?

expected.answer: Settings → Workspace → Data residency. Choose us, eu, or apac. Existing workspaces require support to migrate.

input.question: Can I tell when a teammate last logged in?

expected.answer: Settings → Team → teammate → Last login. Shown to Owners and Admins.

input.question: How do I delete my own attachments?

expected.answer: Sidebar → Attachments → row → Delete. Owners can delete any teammate's attachments via Settings → Storage.

input.question: Are there usage caps on the Free plan?

expected.answer: Yes — 3 projects, 1GB storage, 100 records per project. Hard limits with no overage option.

input.question: Can I add custom workspace branding?

expected.answer: Yes on Team and above — Settings → Workspace → Branding. Logo, accent color, and email sender name.

input.question: How do I move my account to a different region?

expected.answer: Email support@example.com with the workspace ID. Migration takes 1–2 business days and has zero downtime.

input.question: Where do I find my org chart in the platform?

expected.answer: Sidebar → Team → Org chart. Available on Team and Enterprise plans.

input.question: Can teammates see each other's tracked time?

expected.answer: Editors see only their own; Admins see everyone's. Toggle visibility under Workspace → Time → Visibility.

input.question: How do I export a single record?

expected.answer: Record → … → Export → JSON or CSV. Downloads the record plus all custom-field values.

input.question: Where do I configure default sort order?

expected.answer: Each view → Sort → Set as default. Saved per-view.

input.question: Can I disable comments on a single record?

expected.answer: Yes — Record → … → Comments → Disable. Existing comments remain visible.

input.question: How do I share a saved view privately with a teammate?

expected.answer: View menu → Share view → choose teammates. Private shares respect existing project permissions.

input.question: Can a Viewer comment?

expected.answer: Yes by default; Owners can disable Viewer commenting at Settings → Permissions.

input.question: How are admins notified of failed payments?

expected.answer: Email immediately and a banner inside the product until resolved. Three retries over 14 days before the plan downgrades.

input.question: Where do I update my credit card?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Payment method → Update card. Stripe handles the form.

input.question: How do I link projects together?

expected.answer: Open project A → Add link → choose project B. Linked projects show up in each other's sidebar.

input.question: Can I get a custom contract?

expected.answer: Yes for Enterprise — sales@example.com starts the process. Standard contract takes 1 week to negotiate.

input.question: How do I track who downloaded an attachment?

expected.answer: Project → Attachment → History. Shows the last 50 downloads with user and timestamp.

input.question: Can I set a project to read-only?

expected.answer: Yes — Project → Settings → Read-only mode. Editors can no longer add or modify; Owners can lift the lock.

input.question: Where do I configure my notification email address?

expected.answer: Settings → Notifications → Email address. Defaults to your account email but can be overridden.

input.question: Can I export my workspace settings for compliance review?

expected.answer: Yes on Enterprise — Settings → Workspace → Export configuration. JSON dump of all workspace-level settings.

input.question: How do I add a comment that pings a teammate?

expected.answer: @-mention them in the comment text. They receive an in-app and email notification.

input.question: Where do I find my billing PDFs from a year ago?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → History → date filter. Older than 12 months available on request via support@example.com.

input.question: Can teammates see my email if I keep it private?

expected.answer: Owners and Admins always see emails; other roles see only display name unless you opt in to a global directory.

input.question: How do I configure a custom domain for my public links?

expected.answer: Settings → Domains → Add. After DNS verification, public links use yourdomain instead of example.com.

input.question: Can I require all teammates to use SSO?

expected.answer: Yes on Enterprise — Settings → Security → SSO → Enforce. Password login is disabled.

input.question: Where do I find my account creation date?

expected.answer: Settings → Account → Account details. Shows email, creation date, and last password change.

input.question: How are deleted teammates' contributions handled?

expected.answer: Their authorship is preserved on records and comments but their name is shown as Former teammate.

input.question: Can I configure email digest channels?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Notifications → Email → Channels. Direct, Project, and Workspace digests can be toggled independently.

input.question: How do I get a list of my teammates as a CSV?

expected.answer: Settings → Team → … → Export. CSV with role, email, last login, and join date.

input.question: Where do I see what each role can do?

expected.answer: Settings → Team → Roles → role → View permissions. Shows every permission line by line.

input.question: Can I lock workspace-level integrations to admins only?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Integrations → Visibility → Admins only. Editors can use integrations but not add new ones.

input.question: How do I disable a webhook temporarily?

expected.answer: Settings → Webhooks → endpoint → Disable. Re-enable any time without losing the configuration.

input.question: Can I limit the size of comments?

expected.answer: Comments are capped at 8,000 characters. Use an attachment for longer content.

input.question: How do I find which projects are biggest by storage?

expected.answer: Settings → Storage → Projects tab. Sorted by storage consumed.

input.question: Can I get an early-renewal discount?

expected.answer: Annual plans renewed early get a 5% discount. Email sales@example.com to apply.

input.question: Where do I configure auto-archive for old records?

expected.answer: Project → Settings → Auto-archive → Set threshold. Records older than the threshold move to the archive automatically.

input.question: Can I add notes to a teammate's profile?

expected.answer: Yes on Team and above — Settings → Team → teammate → Notes. Notes are visible only to Admins.

input.question: How do I get audit-log line counts for compliance?

expected.answer: Settings → Audit log → Stats. Counts by event type, date range, and actor.

input.question: Can I be notified when someone is added to my workspace?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Notifications → Membership changes → On.

input.question: Where do I find the data dictionary for my project?

expected.answer: Project → … → Documentation → Data dictionary. Auto-generated from fields and updated on each schema change.

input.question: How are inactive accounts handled?

expected.answer: Accounts with no login for 180 days are sent a warning email; after 365 days they're disabled. Data is retained for the account owner's recovery.

input.question: Can I prevent specific words in comments?

expected.answer: Yes on Enterprise — Settings → Workspace → Content policy → Add term. Comments matching the term are blocked at post time.

input.question: How do I get a count of records by status?

expected.answer: Project → Group by → Status. Shows counts in the column header.

input.question: Where do I configure default email signature?

expected.answer: Settings → Profile → Email signature. Applied to product emails you send (e.g. share invites).

input.question: Can I revoke a public link I created?

expected.answer: Yes — Project → Share → Manage links → Revoke. Existing visitors lose access immediately.

input.question: How do I add a passkey?

expected.answer: Settings → Security → Passkeys → Add. Supported in modern browsers; falls back to 2FA when unavailable.

input.question: Can I assign tasks to a group?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Workspace → Groups → Create. Group members all get the assignment.

input.question: Where do I see who's about to renew?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Renewal calendar. Shows upcoming renewals for all your workspaces.

input.question: How are time zones handled across teammates?

expected.answer: Each user's display time zone is set under Settings → Profile → Time zone. Notifications quote the recipient's local time.

input.question: Can I use my own domain in webhook payloads?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Webhooks → endpoint → Source domain. Sets the From header on outbound payloads.

input.question: How do I trigger a manual sync to my integration?

expected.answer: Settings → Integrations → integration → Sync now. Useful when scheduled sync hasn't happened yet.

input.question: Where do I configure the default project view?

expected.answer: Open a view → … → Set as default. New project visitors see this view first.

input.question: Can I see usage by individual API token?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → API → token → Usage. Charts of requests and errors over the past 30 days.

input.question: How do I lock down which teammates can invite new members?

expected.answer: Settings → Permissions → Invitations → Roles allowed → toggle. By default only Owners and Admins.

input.question: Can I customize the welcome email new teammates see?

expected.answer: Yes on Team and above — Settings → Notifications → Welcome email → Edit.

input.question: Where do I find the privacy policy and terms?

expected.answer: Footer → Legal. Always pinned to the current version.

input.question: How do I cancel a scheduled downgrade?

expected.answer: Settings → Billing → Plan → Cancel pending change. Available until the change takes effect.

input.question: Can I export comments along with records?

expected.answer: Yes — Project → … → Export → Include comments. Adds a comments column to the CSV.

input.question: How do I share a project with a client without a workspace?

expected.answer: Project → Share → Guest access → Add email. Guests get a read-only link tied to their email; no account creation required.

input.question: Can I disable the welcome tour for new teammates?

expected.answer: Yes on Team and above — Settings → Workspace → Onboarding → Disable tour. New teammates land straight in their workspace.

input.question: How are project versions stored?

expected.answer: Every change creates a version snapshot. Project → History → Versions to browse or restore any prior version within 90 days.

input.question: Can I get a daily summary of all workspace activity?

expected.answer: Yes — Settings → Notifications → Daily summary → On. One email at 8am workspace local time with the prior day's activity.

input.question: Where do I configure custom statuses for tasks?

expected.answer: Project → Schema → Status field → Edit options. Add or rename statuses; each gets its own color.
